'''GeoD''', whose technical package name is '''GeoDownloader''', is a free and open-source desktop application for Windows, macOS and Linux. It is designed for selecting geographic areas, viewing map layers, exporting geospatial data, and managing resumable download tasks.

== OpenStreetMap support ==

GeoD uses OpenStreetMap in two separate workflows:

* It displays OpenStreetMap Standard raster tiles as an interactive basemap.
* It queries selected roads, buildings, points of interest, land-use features and waterways through an [[Overpass API]] endpoint, then converts the response to GeoJSON.

GeoD is not an OpenStreetMap editor and does not upload changes to the OpenStreetMap database.

The public OpenStreetMap Standard tile service must not be used for bulk downloading, prefetching or creating offline tile archives. Users who need offline raster data must use a self-hosted service or a provider whose terms explicitly permit that use. See the [[Tile usage policy]] and [https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright OpenStreetMap copyright and licence] pages.

GeoD uses the canonical <code>tile.openstreetmap.org</code> URL, displays linked attribution on the map, and leaves preview caching to the embedded browser. If a user attempts to create a raster download task with the built-in Standard source, the application presents the policy, recommends switching to an alternative, and requires an explicit decision before creating a task. Proceeding in the application does not grant permission from the service operator or override the tile usage policy.

== Other features ==

* Area selection by map drawing, place search, administrative region, GeoJSON, Shapefile, KML or KMZ
* User-defined XYZ raster tile sources and Mapbox Vector Tile sources
* GeoTIFF, PNG and JPEG raster export with optional polygon clipping
* Esri Wayback imagery browsing
* DEM and 3D Tiles workflows
* Persistent task history, pause/resume support and a movable local tile cache

== Development ==

The application is built with Rust, Tauri, React and TypeScript. Source code, issue tracking and release packages are available from the [https://github.com/gaopengbin/geo-downloader GitHub repository].

GeoD is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the OpenStreetMap Foundation.
